review_description: The sales and quotation process was very professional and informative.  Installation was on-time and done well, with the only minor hiccup that only 4, not the 5 planned, panels could fit on the North facing part of the roof.The lost panel was relocated to the West facing part of the roof.Quest looked after the entire process all the way through to connection to the grid.

Quest were prompt with contacting us for quote and followed up quickly because of a short lockdown in WA. When all ok completed quote and did not pressure us,we chose to go with them because of the professional manner we were treated as well as expertise they exhibited.The install date was agreed and they were very punctual despite the inclement weather. The install and handover went well and very professional. It took longer than anticipated due to the weather.The only issue we have had is with the Fronius software and Quest have been very responsive in resolving this issue and remedying it.We have no hesitation in recommending Quest as a supplier and installer.
From the get go these guys were on the ball, informative and super responsive.The install team did a great job & the system is performing well.
Very professional from the sales staff to the installers. Excellent communication, was kept well informed during the whole process. Highly recommend.
Great service and install. Quest are the only ones to customise the system for my current and future needs .

I had three quotes and to be honest  all were reasonable. What tipped the scales for me to use Quest Energy was the sales engineer Moe who had an in-depth knowledge of the equipment he was selling. No hyper sales talk, just honest advice. The icing on the cake were the two installers. They started and finished the job without a hitch. I was very impressed with the whole deal and would recommend Quest Energy. Oh! And a big shout out to Solar Quotes.

We requested 2 quotes through the Solar Quotes process (and sourced one further ourselves) and chose Quest as they took the time to explain the process and weigh up the pros and cons of various options for our house. Quest also provided a model showing estimated solar output over the course of a year, which was really helpful with our understanding of what the system would do in different seasons.Prior to installation Quest kept us up to date with progress towards the install. On the installation day the process went smoothly and the install team did a great job.Customer service was excellent. Quest guided us through the Sungrow app once the system was commissioned, showing us how to read the data out of the app.

We had the completion of our install delayed due to rain but they kept me informed all the way. The installers were good and kept me advised every step of the way and consulted me for any options on location of equipment etc.Happy with the system and company but not to impressed with the Fronius app and access to data older than 3 days. They want you to pay for it when other inverter companies offer it for free.

(a) Sales/quoting process was pleasant, thorough and well explained; devoid of push or pressure, strong emphasis on 'customer first' approach.(b) All of the above; polite, tidy and punctual. Advance notifications about appointments and arrival time was excellent.(c) Did more than help with grid connection, they connected and set us up - we just needed to load the app onto our mobiles.Could not be more pleased with this company

Quest Energy was one of 3 quotes we obtained through the Solar Quotes process and we found Moe was very professional and knowledgeable. He was very mindful of our needs at our stage of life and was happy to quote on various combinations of panels and inverters to achieve a good balance of quality products and price. The system was installed by their own installers not subcontractors within one week of making our decision and we couldn’t fault the work of Michael and Cameron. We would highly recommend choosing Quest Energy to supply and install your solar PV system.

Quest stood out from the first meeting in terms of professionalism, knowledge and preparedness/ability to discuss and explain all aspects with a non-technical purchaser. They were polite, patient and not at all pushy - and their installer thoroughly inspected the property prior to quotation in order to be accurate and to come up with a layout that best suited our needs.  This was extremely helpful and meant that we could arrange to have the TV aerial moved prior to installation day, as well ensuring that the panels were positioned with a view to other possible future renovations. We took our time to decide, and asked many (no doubt tortuous and detailed) questions.  Quest responded quickly and helpfully to all of these.  The installation was also impressively done, despite taking longer than planned and with some challenges due to bad weather, and the team took the time to make sure it was achieved very discreetly with the new switchboard and Enphase system placed neatly in an existing laundry cupboard and all wiring hidden.  All of the Quest team were a pleasure to deal with and completely reliable - I would have no hesitation in recommending them.
Excellent customer service from initial consultation through to clean-up after the installation.

Quest Energy was great.Communication was efficient and polite with different options for your budget which was nice, I got so much information, including showing the possibilities I could gain by using solar ect. They sorted out all the paper work with Western power and permits ect which is nice.Installation was fantastic as well the two guys were on time, friendly and very efficient, the work around the inverter was very tidy and no mess was left behind which I like as that rarely happens these days.
From sales pitch to securing our new system on the roof pitch. Moe and the team were friendly and professional. Highly recommended for a job well done..

Excellent service from start to finish. The salesperson from Quest Energy who inspected our property made sure we knew everything about the product and we were able to choose a system to suit our needs and budget. The installation was flawless and our system was operating on our roof a week after we had agreed and paid the deposit to proceed. Could not fault their service and would recommend them to anyone thinking of installing solar.

Quest prepared a quote with detailed, accurate and up to date reference to my property. Others didn’t. The rep explained my choices clearly. I chose reputable brands for inverter and panels not being interested in the cheapest quotes for budget systems. Instalation was prompt and efficient with all requirements completed on the day of instalation. Follow up phone calls confirmed that all was working as expected. I am happy with the purchase and choice of supplier.
I’m happy i’ve got the quotes and to know which company to pick from . And very happy i made the right choice Thank you
Excellent. Came out discussed all the inns and outs. Quality and follow up

Quest Energy have provided us with excellent customer service from start to finish. The price they gave us was also cheaper then the other quotes that we got. Moe Chami is very knowledgeable and was always available to answer any questions.The Installation process was a breeze, everything went to plan. We would definitely recommend Quest Energy.

The team from Quest Energy was very professional and accommodating. We went with Quest as we had roof spacing and shading issues that necessitated proper planning. They spent the time upfront to get the optimal location of the solar panels.The install on the day went smoothly.

Went with getting three quotes through Solarquotes. Went through the quotation phase and settled on Quest Energy on the basis of getting exactly what we wanted, price and the requisite quality of product. The final arrangement was a 6.6 kW panels (LG Mono X)/ 5 kW SolarEdge inverter and installed mid December.We experienced a very professional and efficient exercise from the quotation phase through to installation and after installation follow-up. Mo (engineer/quoter) was very knowledgeable, personable and helpful during the quotation phase and very prompt in providing the quote and other information and made some great suggestions in during the quotation meeting (especially given our shading issue).Once we got to installation, the installation team led by Michael was very slick and thorough and went through their planning and deployment very methodically and with great focus on safety (awesome to see) and with great teamwork (I was around all day to observe). The guys were very friendly and Michael worked out a way to tweak the installation to improve the panel arrangement in respect of the shading challenge. Would definitely use them again!

From start to finish, the team at Quest has been super helpful and knowledgeable.They were not pushy at all which is why they stood out from the rest.Best products in the market, we went with LG panels and Fronius inverter and Michael showed us the benefits of having a smart meter which has helped us in reducing our electrical bills.I will definitely be recommending Quest Electrical and Solar to family and friends
Painless process, came to the property quoted on the install, gave helpful information.High quality installation happy with the result
Quest Solar was extremely helpful and performed a timely and well setup installation.
